An '''All Terrain Armored Transport''' was stationed on the forest moon of [[Endor]] in [[4 ABY]], being commanded by [[Commander]] [[Altadan Igar]]. Igar used the walker to bring the captured [[Luke Skywalker]] to [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], and then used it to continue searching for rebels in the forest.<ref name="SWE6" />
